title: Bali Couples Escape with Rafting
alt: Batur hot springs beside the crater lake, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Mount Batur
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Villa resort with a pool, a short ride from Ubud town

activities.name: Central Bali in a vintage Volkswagen
activities.match: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul
activities.description: A day out in an open top vintage Volkswagen taking in the Bali swing, Tegenungan waterfall, the spring temple at Tirta Empul and the rice terraces.

activities.name: Mount Batur with the hot springs
activities.description: A guided climb on the volcano with the Kintamani crater view, then an hour in the Batur hot springs beside the lake.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: An hour of traditional Balinese massage for both of you after the climb, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a spa in Ubud.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Three nights near Ubud with a vintage car day through central Bali, a volcano morning on Mount Batur and the hot springs afterwards.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Nusa Penida and Uluwatu
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Legian with a rooftop pool

activities.name: Quad bikes and Ayung river rafting
activities.description: A two seat quad bike route in the morning, then twelve kilometres of grade two rapids on the Ayung river through jungle gorges.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west with Paluang cliff
activities.description: Speedboat across for the Paluang cliff viewpoint, Kelingking beach and the rock arch at Angel's Billabong, with Broken Bay after it.

activities.name: Water sports, Melasti and Uluwatu
activities.description: Banana boat and jet ski at Tanjung Benoa, the white sand at Melasti beach, then Uluwatu temple and the Kecak dance at sunset.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights in Legian with a rafting day, a full island day on Nusa Penida and a south coast day that ends at Uluwatu.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your villa resort near Ubud
First evening free by the pool
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Ubud art market
2: Breakfast, then a day out in an open top vintage Volkswagen
The Bali swing and Tegenungan waterfall
Tirta Empul, the holy spring temple
The Tegalalang rice terraces on the way back
3: Early breakfast, then up to the Mount Batur slopes
The Kintamani crater view across the lake
An hour in the Batur hot springs
An hour of Balinese massage for two back in Ubud
4: Breakfast and check out, then a tandem quad bike route
Rice fields, a river crossing and a cave tunnel
Twelve kilometres of rafting on the Ayung river
Private transfer down to Legian and check in
5: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
The Paluang cliff, Kelingking beach and Angel's Billabong
Return boat to Bali and back to your hotel
6: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat and jet ski with an instructor
Melasti beach, white sand below the cliffs
Uluwatu temple and the Kecak fire dance at sunset
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Couples who want more than beaches take this one. A volcano, a river and three island days, with a Marriott at the end.
expert.tip: The hot springs after Batur are the part everyone underrates, so carry swimwear up with you. Rafting falls on moving day, so keep one small bag out and we will move the rest.

summary: Seven days for active couples: three nights near Ubud with a vintage car day, Mount Batur and the hot springs, then three in Legian with quad bikes and rafting on the Ayung river, Nusa Penida and sunset at Uluwatu.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; central Bali tour in a vintage Volkswagen; Mount Batur with the hot springs; Balinese massage for two; quad bike ride with Ayung river rafting; Nusa Penida west coast tour; water sports with Melasti and Uluwatu.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
